title: Patient Cost-Share Terms by Payer Program — Wound Care Supply Program
content:
# Patient cost-share terms — Wound Care Supply Program

This schedule sets, for each tier of the Wound Care Supply Program, the coinsurance, the copay, whether the plan's deductible applies and whether the patient responsibility is crossed over to a secondary coverage.

## Definitions

- **Coinsurance** is the patient's share as a whole percent of the payer-allowed amount on each claim line after any deductible. On the Wound Care Self-Pay Program it is instead the share of the Larkfield cash price that the customer pays.
- **Copay** is the flat patient copay, in USD, the plan applies per 30-day supply on a claim line (0.00 means the plan applies no copay); it informs the expected patient responsibility that the payer remittance confirms.
- **Deductible applies** states whether the plan's annual deductible applies to this product line before coinsurance. The deductible amount itself is the payer's and arrives on the remittance.
- **Crossover to secondary** states whether the patient responsibility left by the primary payer is automatically crossed over to an in-effect secondary coverage before any patient statement.

## Schedule

| Tier | Coinsurance | Copay per 30-day supply | Deductible applies | Crossover to secondary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Wound Care Self-Pay Program | 100% (of the Larkfield cash price) | USD 0.00 | No | No |
| Wound Care Commercial HMO Program | 0% | USD 35.00 | No | No |
| Wound Care Commercial PPO Program | 20% | USD 0.00 | Yes | No |
| Wound Care Medicare Advantage Program | 20% | USD 0.00 | No | No |
| Wound Care Original Medicare Program | 20% | USD 0.00 | Yes | Yes |
| Wound Care Medicaid Program | 0% | USD 0.00 | No | No |

## Notes on the schedule

- The Wound Care Original Medicare Program is the only tier on which the primary payer's patient responsibility crosses over automatically to an in-effect secondary coverage.
- The deductible applies on two tiers, the Wound Care Commercial PPO Program and the Wound Care Original Medicare Program; on those tiers the coinsurance is taken on the allowed amount after the deductible the remittance shows.
- The Wound Care Commercial HMO Program is the only tier with a flat copay, USD 35.00 per 30-day supply on a claim line, and it carries no coinsurance.

## Worked illustration (hypothetical figures)

A claim line on the Wound Care Medicare Advantage Program has a hypothetical allowed amount of USD 150.00 and no deductible applies on that tier. The coinsurance of 20% of USD 150.00 is USD 30.00, which is the expected patient share for that line. On the Wound Care Self-Pay Program, a hypothetical order with a Larkfield cash price of USD 64.50 is paid 100% by the customer, that is USD 64.50.
